  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Soak {{ing_01|nuts}}, dry them, and also have {{ing_02|fresh sea-urchins}} ready. Take a deep dish [casserole] in which arrange the following things [in layers]: {{ing_03|medium-sized mallows}} and {{ing_04|beets}}, {{ing_05|mature leeks}}, {{ing_06|celery}}, {{ing_07|stewed tender green cabbage}}, and {{ing_08|other boiled green vegetables}}, a {{ing_09|disjointed chicken stewed in its own gravy}}, {{ing_10|cooked [calf’s or pig’s] brains}}, {{ing_11|Lucanian sausage}}, {{ing_12|hard boiled eggs cut into halves}}, {{ing_13|big Tarentinian sausage}} sliced and broiled in the ashes, {{ing_14|chicken giblets or pieces of chicken meat}}. {{ing_15|Bits of fried fish}}, {{ing_16|sea nettles}}, {{ing_17|pieces of [stewed] oysters}} and {{ing_18|fresh cheese}} are alternately put together; sprinkle in between the {{ing_01|nuts}} and {{ing_19|whole pepper}}, and the {{ing_20|juice as is cooked from pepper, lovage, celery seed and silphium}}. This essence, when done, mix with {{ing_21|milk}} to which {{ing_22|raw eggs}} have been added [pour this over the pieces of food in the dish] so that the whole is thoroughly combined, stiffen it [in the hot water bath] and when done [garnish with] {{ing_23|fresh mussels [sea-urchins, poached and chopped fine]}} sprinkle {{ing_24|pepper}} over and serve."
    }
